newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria 1996 retail sales fall 9.3 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria 1996 retail sales fall 9.3 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Bulgarian retail sales in 1996 were a real 9.3 percent lower than in 1995, National Statistics Institute (NSI) figures show.
BULGARIA RETAIL SALES JAN-DEC JAN-NOV JAN-DEC'95

"The deep economic crisis, high inflation and the declining purchasing power of the population were the main reasons for the fall in retail sales," NSI director Zahari Karamfilov told a news conference.
Food sales fell a real 10.3 percent year-on-year and sales of non-foods were a real 7.8 percent lower in 1996.
Year-on-year inflation was 310.8 percent in December, erasing some 70 percent of Bulgarians' real income last year, the NSI said.
